long_biography.plain_text:
Poole began learning the family dealership from the ground up, sweeping the parts-department floor at eight and working in its workshop as a teenager. After business studies and an MBA, he moved through product support, service, marketing and power-systems roles before becoming president and chief operating officer in 1996.

He purchased the company from his father three years later, assuming third-generation ownership and executive leadership. Under Poole, the dealership added branches, lift systems and other equipment lines while extending its sales, rental, parts and servicing capabilities. His management approach has emphasised delegated decision-making and staff development, and the business remains family owned as another generation works within the group.
